instruction: A candid studio photograph captured in a medium close-up from a high angle. Against a plain white background, the woman with straight brown hair (R1) sits on the left, leaning her head on the shoulder of the woman with curly dark hair (R2) who sits on the right. Both women have their eyes closed in a peaceful, serene moment. R1's hand rests gently on R2's shoulder. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates the scene, creating a gentle, intimate mood with a neutral color palette.
